plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for LANCOM LCOS-SX Ethernet switches (PEN 2356). Reports chassis temps, free memory MB, fan status/speed and PSU status plus IF-MIB/uptime.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of the LANCOM LCOS-SX switch in degrees Celsius (lcsSystemInfoTemperatureSensor1/2/3 scalars), aggregated as the maximum across sensors.

metrics.name: lancom_memory_free_mb
metrics.description: Free system memory of the LANCOM LCOS-SX switch in megabytes (lcsSystemInfoFreeMemory scalar).

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan module state of the LANCOM LCOS-SX switch (lcsMonitoringFanState). operational(2), powering(4) and present(9) map to 1 (normal); every other defined module state maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed of the LANCOM LCOS-SX switch in revolutions per minute (lcsMonitoringFanSpeed Gauge32).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply module state of the LANCOM LCOS-SX switch (lcsMonitoringPSUState). operational(2), powering(4) and present(9) map to 1 (normal); every other defined module state maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
